reason_for_amendment: Repository audit established that all six proposed institutions predate M3 in the broader MAR corpus, while none occurs in the 117 human-labelled M3 development units and no direct runtime dependency from the audited M3 classifier to those six corpus exports was found. The claim is therefore narrowed prospectively before independent execution.
research_question: Does M3 2.3.0 classify previously unlabelled public digital surfaces from six institutions that are absent from all prior human-labelled M3 development sets, under the sealed sampling and blinding procedure?

primary_claim_scope.allowed: Performance of the frozen M3 candidate on previously unlabelled selected surfaces and new human labels from the six preregistered institutions, all held out from prior human-labelled M3 development sets.
not_allowed: generalisation to institutions wholly unseen by the MAR project
prevalence of surface classes in the institutions or Europe
completeness of discovery or institutional holdings
validity of the entire MAR platform
institutional use of AI or AI participation in audiovisual content
M4 promotion unless all separate preregistered gates permit a later decision

corpus_relationship.interpretation: Prior MAR corpus membership is disclosed as a limitation of global institutional novelty, not as demonstrated label leakage.

unchanged_from_base_protocol: sampling depth, page and unit caps
minimum sample rule and no replacement policy
blinding field contract and prediction custody principle
freeze order and fail-closed integrity rules
prohibition on post-freeze tuning and M4 automatic promotion

exposure_and_exclusion_state.requirement: The sealed exclusion manifest may grow prospectively from 137 but may not shrink below verified evidence. Any addition must have a documented evidence class and reviewer decision before new collection.

prospective_decision.rationale: The validation target is the M3 instrument on new labels/surfaces. Absolute institutional novelty to the whole MAR project is a different research question and is not required for this instrument-validation claim.

required_before_seal: independent reviewer accepts or rejects this prospective claim amendment
finish review of 22 test strings and eight reconstructed expressions
materialize and review the final exclusion/alias manifest
freeze a final 2.3.0 candidate commit rather than a development reference
designate distinct custodian and human reviewer roles
provide restricted durable prediction storage inaccessible to the reviewer
define retention of all raw evidence including non-selected pages
obtain an authenticated external seal/witness for the protocol and freeze artifacts
run all fail-closed readiness checks before any independent collection
prohibited: do not visit the six targets to refine this amendment
do not generate or inspect new candidate predictions before protocol sealing
do not select replacement entities based on model outcomes
do not describe the six institutions as globally unseen in MAR
do not call this amendment an independent validation or scientific seal
do not alter historical VAL-007 results or reuse its labels as VAL-009 evidence
